role: Expert YouTube thumbnail art director, cinematic 2D cartoon illustrator, and custom display typography designer
task: Generate a premium 16:9 illustrated YouTube thumbnail based on the supplied video topic. Reproduce the visual style, mascot design, composition, lighting, and distinctive typography of the four supplied reference images as accurately as possible. The only permanent change to the mascot is replacing its blue hoodie with a heather-gray quarter-zip jacket with a gold zip pull. All typography must remain horizontal, straight, and naturally proportioned.

input.reference_images: Use the four supplied images as primary visual references for character proportions, linework, rendering, lighting, composition, and typography.

output.instruction: Generate only the final image. Do not output explanations, concepts, or text descriptions.

reference_style.description: Extremely polished, high-contrast 2D digital cartoon illustration combining expressive animated characters, bold comic-book linework, sophisticated cel shading, richly colored cinematic environments, dramatic perspective, and giant illustrated thumbnail lettering.
visual_identity: Warm golden and orange environmental highlights
Selective cyan, violet, and magenta accent lighting
Massive horizontal white-and-yellow text with thick black outlines
reference_style.medium: Professional 2D digital illustration, never a 3D render

rendering.linework: Thick smooth black exterior contour lines with thinner interior lines and subtle organic variation
rendering.shading: Detailed angular cel-shaded shadows combined with smooth gradients in naturally illuminated areas
rendering.highlights: Selective sharp highlights, soft glow, and colored environmental reflections
rendering.surfaces: Polished stylized materials without photorealistic textures
rendering.depth: Sharp foreground, dimensional midground, softer atmospheric background
rendering.finish: Premium animated comic-book illustration with exceptionally clean contours

main_character.identity: Distinctive cartoon humanoid mascot with a perfectly round black head, minimal off-white facial features, and a heather-gray quarter-zip jacket with a gold zip pull.

head.shape: Large smooth spherical silhouette, perfectly round and oversized
head.surface: Nearly pure matte black with restrained reflected highlights
head.outline: Heavy smooth black contour occasionally accented with violet or magenta rim lighting
head.proportions: Significantly larger than a realistic human head
head.restrictions: No hair, ears, nose, visible skin, or realistic facial anatomy

face.eye_design: Minimal off-white expressive cartoon eyes with thick curved upper eyelids
face.mouth: Simple off-white curved smile, smirk, or scene-appropriate expression
face.default_expression: Confident slightly mischievous half-lidded expression with a playful smirk
face.rule: Preserve the exact minimalist visual language of the reference mascot's eyes and mouth. Change expressions only to suit the scene.

hoodie.type: Fitted quarter-zip cartoon pullover jacket with a short chest zip
hoodie.hood: No hood: a small stand-up collar at the neck
hoodie.drawstrings: A short gold zip pull at the chest, no drawstrings
hoodie.sleeves: Fitted sleeves with angular stylized folds
hoodie.shading: Deep charcoal cel-shaded shadows and soft silver highlights
hoodie.outlines: Thick black exterior contours and clean interior fold lines
hoodie.critical_rule: The jacket must ALWAYS be GRAY, never blue. This is the only permanent modification to the reference character.

body.hands: Simple solid-black cartoon hands with rounded expressive fingers
body.pants: Near-black or dark charcoal cartoon pants
body.shoes: Off-white stylized athletic sneakers when visible
body.build: Stylized animated humanoid body with exaggerated expressive proportions
body.posing: Dramatic energetic poses with strong silhouettes and foreshortening

lighting.face: Remain almost entirely black with extremely subtle reflected light
lighting.rim: Thin purple, magenta, blue, or red highlights around the silhouette
lighting.hoodie: Dimensional gray folds with deep charcoal shadows
lighting.contrast: The mascot must remain clearly separated from the background

lighting.ambient: Deep saturated purple and midnight-blue atmospheric lighting
lighting.practical_lights: Warm glowing windows, lamps, neon signs, or environmental light sources
lighting.bloom: Localized luminous glow around genuinely bright objects
lighting.contrast: Deep shadows with vibrant selected highlights

background.generation: Create a location directly relevant to the video topic
background.depth: Three-layer foreground, midground, and atmospheric background
background.focus: Keep the main subject and action crisp while softening distant details
background.palette: Prefer purple, indigo, violet, and warm golden lighting where appropriate
background.complexity: Visually rich but never distractingly cluttered

effects: Dramatic perspective for illustrated objects and environments
cinematic_art_direction.important_distinction: Dramatic perspective is encouraged for characters, objects, and environments, but NEVER for typography. Text must remain flat and frontal.

automatic_thumbnail_text.instruction: Analyze the supplied video topic and independently create the shortest, strongest, most visually compelling thumbnail text. The text should feel like the references rather than a generic YouTube title.

word_count.rule: Use the fewest words possible. One or two words are often strongest.

writing_rules: Avoid repeating the exact video title unless effective.
Favor emotional impact over informational completeness.
Use occasional punctuation when it improves the hook.
Use only one primary text block.
Choose a phrase that complements the scene.

text_examples.topic: What if you could stop time?
What if you had super speed?
What if you could read minds?
What if you could control gravity?
What if you never needed sleep?

selection_process: Identify the most exciting emotional implication.
Select the simplest and strongest phrase.
Choose the dominant word for yellow emphasis.
Determine whether a one-line or two-line horizontal arrangement is strongest.
Include only the final selected phrase.

typography_system.priority: EXTREMELY CRITICAL — REFERENCE MATCHING AND HORIZONTAL GEOMETRY
typography_system.visual_reference: Match the actual shapes, proportions, spacing, scale, coloring, outlines, and shadows of the lettering in the supplied reference thumbnails, especially TOO SLOW., PAUSED., and I ALREADY WON.

typography_identity.style: Massive custom illustrated cartoon block lettering
typography_identity.appearance: Extremely heavy, chunky, broad, tightly packed uppercase letters with subtle organic character
typography_identity.font_instruction: Do not default to ordinary Impact or Anton. Reproduce the custom-looking exaggerated letterforms in the reference images.
typography_identity.character: Bold, playful, powerful, exceptionally readable, almost sticker-like
typography_identity.rendering_method: Custom graphic lettering visually integrated into the illustration while preserving perfectly natural typography geometry

letter_geometry.weight: Extremely heavy, equivalent to an exaggerated 950-1000 font weight
letter_geometry.stroke_mass: Exceptionally thick letter bodies while preserving legibility
letter_geometry.width: Broad chunky capitals rather than skinny condensed lettering
letter_geometry.corners: Slightly rounded or softened squared corners
letter_geometry.terminals: Thick blunt terminals with subtle cartoon-like rounding
letter_geometry.counters: Small clean negative spaces inside letters such as A, O, P, B, and R
letter_geometry.proportions: Natural consistent proportions without artificial stretching
avoid: Inconsistent glyph widths caused by stretching

letter_spacing.kerning: Optically compressed so adjacent letters appear closely packed
letter_spacing.shape_goal: Each word should form one powerful compact graphic silhouette
letter_spacing.rule: Do not stretch words to fill space. Adjust font size or layout instead.

yellow.use: Most important emotional or action word
yellow.surface: Rich bright golden-yellow with minimal shading

text_fill.color_limit: Only white and golden yellow for primary lettering

black_outline.importance: One of the most important characteristics
black_outline.word_shape: Outlines of neighboring letters may nearly merge into a continuous dark silhouette
black_outline.rule: Letters should resemble bold physical cut-out stickers with massive black boundaries.

shadow.avoid: Large blurry gray shadows or generic glowing text

text_layering.layer_1: Solid bright white or golden-yellow fill
text_layering.visual_goal: Extremely bold lettering recognizable at tiny thumbnail sizes

horizontal_alignment.rule: ALL thumbnail text must remain straight and horizontally oriented. Rotation beyond plus or minus 10 degrees is strictly forbidden.
horizontal_alignment.line_orientation: Every line must follow a straight baseline, without curvature or perspective convergence.
horizontal_alignment.consistency: When multiple lines are present, keep them parallel. Prefer the same rotation for the entire text block.
horizontal_alignment.character_orientation: All letters must remain upright relative to their shared text baseline.
horizontal_alignment.exception: No exceptions to the maximum 10-degree rotation.

perspective_and_distortion.rule: Typography must appear on a perfectly flat plane facing the viewer directly. Never bend, skew, warp, stretch, compress, or distort the text in any direction.
perspective_and_distortion.scaling: Uniform proportional scaling of complete words or lines is permitted.
perspective_and_distortion.important: If the text does not fit, reduce its size, choose a different horizontal line break, or reposition the text block. Never distort the letters to make them fit.

text_size.single_word: May occupy nearly an entire horizontal section of the image
text_size.two_line: Each line can be uniformly scaled independently while maintaining its natural letter proportions
text_size.overall_text_block: Approximately 25-45% of the composition depending on the scene
text_size.emphasis: The yellow payoff word may be significantly larger than the white setup words
text_size.rule: Increase text impact through font size and weight, never geometric distortion.

layout.default: One or two extremely large stacked horizontal lines
layout.alignment: Mostly left-aligned with straight parallel horizontal baselines
layout.line_gap: Extremely small but without overlapping glyphs

rotation.rule: Use rotation only when it provides a meaningful compositional benefit.

perspective.rule: Never apply perspective transformation to any text.

letter_proportions.allowed_scaling: Uniform proportional scaling of complete words or lines

layout.character_overlap: Text may overlap background objects but never the mascot's face
layout.integration: Compose the illustration around the typography without altering typography geometry

white_yellow_hierarchy.rule: For two lines, place supporting words in white above the dominant emotional payoff word in yellow
white_yellow_hierarchy.single_word: Often use yellow for strong one-word reactions
white_yellow_hierarchy.emphasis_word: Choose the most emotionally significant word
white_yellow_hierarchy.size_relationship: The payoff word may be larger, but only through uniform proportional scaling

reference_layout_examples.layout: Two straight parallel horizontal lines, tightly stacked and left-aligned. Yellow word dominates through natural scale, not stretching.
One giant perfectly horizontal yellow word with massive black outline and strong shadow.
Two straight horizontal lines with consistent upright letters, tight spacing, and oversized yellow emphasis.

critical_accuracy_rules: Typography must ALWAYS remain horizontal.
Default to exactly 0 degrees of rotation.
Never exceed 10 degrees clockwise or counterclockwise.
Never apply perspective distortion to text.
Never stretch text horizontally or vertically.
Never skew, bend, curve, warp, or distort lettering.
Never rotate individual letters independently.
Maintain perfectly straight baselines.
Keep all text lines parallel.
Preserve natural consistent letter proportions.
Only scale complete words or lines proportionally.
Match the reference's dense heavy letter geometry.
Match its broad chunky uppercase proportions.
Match its slightly softened corners and thick terminals.
Match its tightly packed natural spacing.
Match its massive solid black outlines.
Match its strong black offset shadows.
Match its flat white and golden-yellow fills.
Match its enormous scale and compact stacked arrangement.
Do not use generic standard bold typography.
Do not use skinny condensed Impact-style lettering.
Ensure exact spelling and clean letter anatomy.
Prioritize professional natural lettering over exaggerated AI-generated text distortions.

automatic_scene_generation.instruction: Transform the supplied topic into one instantly understandable, visually exciting cartoon scene starring the gray-jacket mascot.
process: Identify the most dramatic or interesting implication of the topic.
Determine the most expressive character pose.
Choose a facial expression matching the emotion.
Select the strongest simple thumbnail hook.
Plan horizontal text placement before composing the scene.
Use cinematic perspective for characters and environment.
Keep typography flat, frontal, and undistorted.
Apply polished 2D shading, bold outlines, and rich lighting.

character_behavior.rule: The mascot should actively participate in the story whenever possible.
character_behavior.expression: Choose the most compelling minimalist facial expression
character_behavior.pose: Strong animated gesture, exaggerated perspective, and readable silhouette
character_behavior.energy: Confident, lively, expressive, and visually engaging

storytelling.clarity: The central idea should be understood within one second
storytelling.simplicity: One major action with one or two supporting visual elements
storytelling.emotion: Curiosity, surprise, danger, excitement, victory, power, or humor
storytelling.text_relationship: The chosen phrase reinforces the visual story without merely describing everything visible

composition.framing: Medium close-up, wide-angle action shot, or dramatic close-up depending on topic
composition.character_scale: Approximately 40-70% of the frame depending on composition
composition.balance: Strong asymmetrical arrangement with character and typography balancing each other
composition.foreground: Crisp bold outlines and sharp details
composition.negative_space: Reserve intentional clear areas for horizontal text
composition.text_geometry: Flat frontal text, straight baselines, natural letter proportions, and no perspective distortion
composition.thumbnail_readability: Every major element must remain identifiable at small mobile sizes

negative_prompt: Hair or ears on the mascot

final_directive.instruction: Create one exceptionally polished 16:9 YouTube thumbnail using the supplied topic and four reference images. Reproduce the reference illustration style as faithfully as possible, including thick cartoon contours, richly shaded characters, dramatic purple-blue cinematic lighting, warm glowing highlights, exaggerated perspective, and clean hand-illustrated appearance. Feature the same black spherical-headed mascot with minimalist off-white facial features, replacing only its original blue hoodie with a heather-gray quarter-zip jacket and a gold zip pull. Automatically generate an extremely short, emotionally compelling thumbnail hook, ideally 1-3 words. Render the hook in massive, custom-looking, ultra-heavy cartoon block lettering matching the reference typography, with chunky uppercase shapes, very tight natural spacing, massive solid black outlines, deep offset shadows, and flat white/yellow fills. All typography must remain perfectly horizontal by default, with a maximum allowable rotation of plus or minus 10 degrees. No perspective warping, stretching, skewing, curved baselines, or individually distorted letters. The text must look professionally typeset while retaining the distinctive illustrated lettering aesthetic. Compose the scene around the text instead of distorting the text to fit. Prioritize exact mascot consistency, cinematic visual storytelling, reference-matched text styling, and natural typography geometry.
final_directive.typography_geometry_is_non_negotiable: ALL thumbnail text must appear straight, horizontal, and naturally proportioned. Prefer 0-degree rotation. Maximum permitted deviation is plus or minus 10 degrees. Absolutely no perspective warping, stretching, skewing, curved baselines, trapezoidal transformations, or individually rotated letters. Achieve visual impact through font weight, scale, white/yellow emphasis, heavy black outlines, and shadows — NEVER geometric distortion.
internal_execution: Choose a visually striking central concept.
Select the strongest minimal thumbnail text.
Set text rotation to 0 degrees by default.
Reserve sufficient space for the undistorted text.
Compose the scene around the typography.
Render massive custom block lettering without stretching or warping.
Verify all text baselines are straight and horizontal.
Verify rotation does not exceed 10 degrees.
Verify the text is spelled correctly.
Verify hoodie color and character consistency.
